name: dingding-zones
description: Shared web core for DingDing Zones browser, Windows and iOS shells

scripts.build:all: npm test && npm run build:web && npm run ios:sync && npm --prefix web-easy run build
scripts.ios:add: npm run build:ios-web && cap add ios && node scripts/fix-capacitor-ios-paths.js
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:ios-web && cap sync ios && node scripts/fix-capacitor-ios-paths.js
scripts.desktop:check: npm run build:web && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
